findings.title: The 'Confirmed non-regression' analysis for authType:"optional" stops at getCredentialRequirement() and misses getProviderCategory(), which flips ollama-local's resilience/circuit-breaker profile from apikey to oauth
findings.location: Section 3, Step 1, 'Confirmed non-regression of URL/header building' and 'Accepted side effect' paragraphs
findings.fix: Set authType: "apikey" instead of "optional" on the new registry entry (preserves today's resilience bucket while still matching the credential story), or explicitly analyze and get sign-off on moving every ollama-local connection from the apikey PROVIDER_PROFILES bucket (15 failures/30min window/10min cooldown) to the oauth bucket (10 failures/15min window/5min cooldown) consumed by providerCooldownTracker.ts, rateLimitManager.ts, errorClassifier.ts, and accountFallback.ts — directly relevant since the bug report's own symptom is a connection going unhealthy after a 500.

findings.title: Step 4's overrideLookup wiring adds an uncached synchronous SQLite read to the hot forwarding path and misdescribes it as 'the same cost class' as an existing cached pattern
findings.location: Section 3, Step 4, 'An operator override ... always wins' paragraph
findings.fix: Cache getReasoningEffortsOverride the same way getParamFilterConfig is cached (in-memory map invalidated on write), or scope the override lookup to only fire when a static vocabulary is already declared (gate behind declaredRanked.length > 0). Correct or drop the claim that this matches the @/lib/db/paramFilters precedent — that precedent reads from an in-memory cache (loadParamFilterConfigs/filterCache), not a per-call DB query, and no other current caller of getReasoningEffortsOverride/getModelCapabilityOverride omits the bulk/snapshot parameter in a per-request path.
